The '''memory moth''' was a type of [[Moth/Legends|moth]] native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]]. When released, they held a single name that they whispered back. They were also considered [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]]. Memory moths were then released into a [[Jedi monument (New Holstice)|giant cylinder]] where thousands more were held, each one commemorating every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that ever [[Death/Legends|died]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used these after the [[Battle of Jabiim]] for the deaths of his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] friends, the [[Padawan Pack]].

Glowing insects strongly resembling memory moths appeared on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in [[137 ABY]] when [[Wolf Sazen]], [[K'Kruhk]] and [[Shado Vao]] were meditating in a garden.
